id.description: Item ID copied exactly from the input

cwe_dirujuk.description: Single CWE identifier such as CWE-89, copied from the item

langkah.description: Two to four remediation steps in Bahasa Indonesia, in the order they should be carried out

potongan_kode_usulan.description: Optional corrected code excerpt, at most 15 lines, same language as the original

catatan_risiko.description: One to three sentences in Bahasa Indonesia on what could break or still needs manual checking
